notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Merfolk" on Judge of Currents to either "Vampire" or "Knight" until end of turn.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
